review_findings: The new shared capture FSM fills the specific missing common-edge coherence function. It preserves accepted12/13 byte identities and requires no new public ABI, pin, clock, register/HWH, profile or board authorization.

A common observed rising mask111 establishes a shared R0. Per-lane first falls and a later common R1 support one whole raw interval. Rejecting any proper-subset rise during a partial prevents an earlier/later lane interval from being spliced into a coherent record. Numeric period equality alone is never sufficient.

Rearm samples a baseline at local tick0 and never counts that edge as R0; actual start>=1. Witnesses are nonwrapping local window indices, with start<end and period=end-start. Tag reuse/zero remains opaque and cannot establish unique request or applied-command identity.

The namespace-exhaustion rule is distinct from a missing-signal watchdog: processing at t==TMAX is legal, but the next armed edge disarms and clears the partial without manufacturing TMAX+1 or wrapping. It occurs once even when idle, with explicit rearm needed for further acquisition.

Result transport is correctly independent of armed: a pre-existing complete record may retire on the exhaustion edge or later unarmed edges and stays stable while stalled. Its transport-valid status grants no freshness, waveform liveness or motion eligibility.

Period overflow uses old age==CMAX, making elapsed CMAX legal and CMAX+1 invalid. Only a representable genuine common rising can restart on that period-overflow edge. Witness exhaustion has priority and forbids that restart when its own next tick is unrepresentable.

The fault priority witness_overflow > period_overflow > incoherent > overrun is consistent with candidate eligibility. Exactly one event increments saturating fault_count per edge. Its count is fault/drop notifications, not an asserted number of lost physical frames.

Reset/STOP outrank rearm, both suppress old transport handshakes and clear window/queue/diagnostics. Ordinary retire/refill has no bypass; stalled payload remains whole and the frontend continues independently.

The independent acceptance plan addresses actual common-edge/phase mismatch, extra/missing edges, abort windows, timestamp and period boundaries, queue behavior and isolated mutant rejection. COUNT_W2/3 legal high triples total9+441=450 when witness width is sufficient. The full16-bit65535/65536 tests likewise require adequate witness width; min-witness tests exercise a deliberately shorter representable window.

Synchronous sample observations cannot reveal unsampled transitions or infer constant-channel duty/period. After-real-command capture, source/session/request/control_epoch/capture_seq, physical time, freshness/TTL/profile/curvature and both complete control chains remain open G05/system integration gates.
